svg.title: Cloud Credit Packages Have Different Entry Conditions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-cloud-credit-package-ladder; chapter number: 6; title: Cloud Credit Packages Have Different Entry Conditions; subtitle: Separate reported package amounts from eligibility, coverage periods, and the recurring bill.; caption: XRaise describes Google startup coverage and AWS Activate packages with different qualification routes.; assumptions note: The XRaise amounts are independent package references arranged by size, not successive funnel populations. No applicant conversion rates or guaranteed awards are reported.; note: XRaise recommends checking the AWS credit expiration date and setting a budget alert. Trapture Explains emphasizes that credits are temporary while the monthly bill remains.; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Google AI first-year ceiling; value: 250000; display: Up to $250,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes first-year coverage of 100% of usage up to this amount for AI startups; qualification is separate from the headline ceiling.; label: AWS Portfolio ceiling; value: 200000; display: Up to $200,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes the provider-linked Activate Portfolio route, requiring an Activate provider Org ID.; label: Google first-year standard ceiling; value: 100000; display: Up to $100,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes first-year coverage of 100% of usage up to this standard amount, distinct from the AI ceiling.; label: Selected AWS Founders awards; value: 5000; display: Up to $5,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise reports selected Founders awards up to this amount; this is not an automatic upgrade.; label: AWS Founders starting package; value: 1000; display: $1,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes Founders as the direct route for self-funded startups.

rect.title: label: Google AI first-year ceiling; value: 250000; display: Up to $250,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes first-year coverage of 100% of usage up to this amount for AI startups; qualification is separate from the headline ceiling.

label: AWS Portfolio ceiling; value: 200000; display: Up to $200,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes the provider-linked Activate Portfolio route, requiring an Activate provider Org ID.

label: Google first-year standard ceiling; value: 100000; display: Up to $100,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes first-year coverage of 100% of usage up to this standard amount, distinct from the AI ceiling.

label: Selected AWS Founders awards; value: 5000; display: Up to $5,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise reports selected Founders awards up to this amount; this is not an automatic upgrade.
label: AWS Founders starting package; value: 1000; display: $1,000; conversion: Not a conversion rate; detail: XRaise describes Founders as the direct route for self-funded startups.

text.title: Assumptions: The XRaise amounts are independent package references arranged by size, not successive funnel populations. No applicant conversion rates or guaranteed awards are reported.
